messages:
rina: Quick follow-up from the PM: last night's TLS/cipher incident caused cross-region handshake failures and cascading retries. Root cause: load balancer cipher-priority fell back to a legacy list when the preferred cipher-suite probe failed, sending traffic to an older pool that can't keep up. Posting action items and owners, pls ack and update ETAs.

infra-bot: Postmortem published: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-22-tls-cipher-fallback (tags: tls, lb, dns, postmortem) :spiral_note_pad:

jay: +1 on summary. Additional datapoint: cert rotations around 02:10 UTC increased TLS handshakes; our LB health probe hit the older pool because the new pool returned a 421 during probe window. Probe timeout + cipher fallback combo = retry storms.

zara: I'll own the LB cipher-priority and probe sequencing change. Plan: update config to prefer modern suites and add a delayed fallback (5s backoff) before switching pools. Will test in staging then canary. ETA: 2026-03-29.

sam: can we add a fast integration test? propose a tiny harness using openssl to validate handshake chain + cipher negotiation across pools:
```
# verify-cipher.sh
openssl s_client -connect edge.redwood.ai:443 -tls1_2 -cipher "ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256" -servername edge.redwood.ai < /dev/null | grep "Cipher is"
```
We can run this in CI against canary pool.

zara: nice. will add to canary smoke. also adding a config flag to avoid immediate hard-failover if probe returns unexpected response code.

ops-lead: scheduling follow-up sync: Thurs 09:30 UTC, recurring weekly for 6 weeks to watch for regressions. Inviteing lb, tls, and oncall.

rina: about short-term mitigation: ops suggested temporarily raising probe timeout to 3s and disabling cipher fallback for <10m windows during cert rotation. Risk: may mask some bad backends. Need signoff from owners + oncall.

jay: if we do that, add an automated rollback (400 lines? jk) — really: add a health metric check that auto-undoes if 5xx increases by >1% over 5m.

sam: I'll own the rollback automation snippet in runbook; ETA: 2026-03-24 COB.

zara: PR will include runbook updates and the openssl smoke test. ETA PR: 2026-03-26.

rina: action items recap:
- ZARA: LB cipher-priority + delayed fallback change (owner) — ETA 2026-03-29
- SAM: add openssl smoke test to CI + rollback automation (owner) — ETA 2026-03-24 COB
- JAY: validate cert rotation window + coordinate with cert infra (owner) — ETA 2026-03-25
- OPS-LEAD: set up weekly regression sync and invite list (owner) — scheduled 2026-03-26 09:30 UTC recurring

ops-lead: acked. I'll also add a dashboard panel for cross-region TLS handshake failures and a derived metric retry_rate_by_region.

rina: thanks all. please update the postmortem doc with PR links and mark any blockers. I'll close thread once we have a canary run + 24h stable signal. :white_check_mark:
